title: Volt
summary: VOLT, noun [Latin volutus, volvo.] 1. a round or circular tread; a gait of two treads, made by a horse going sideways round a center. 2. In fencing, a sudden movement or leap to avoid a thrust. VOLTa,

inlines.v: VOLT, noun [Latin volutus, volvo.] 1. a round or circular tread; a gait of two treads, made by a horse going sideways round a center. 2. In fencing, a sudden movement or leap to avoid a thrust. VOLTa, in Italian music, signifies that the part is to be repeated one, two or more times.
